---
title: Installation
description: How to install INIF and its optional converter extras.
llms-description: Install INIF from PyPI; pick optional extras for Inspect AI or every_eval_ever support.
---

## Requirements

- Python 3.10 or newer.
- [`pydantic`](https://docs.pydantic.dev) (>= 2.0) and
  [`transformers`](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers) — installed
  automatically.

## From PyPI

Install the core package:

``` bash
pip install inif
```

The core install is enough to read and write `.inif.json` / `.inif` files,
build documents from raw text via [`from_texts`](../converters/text.qmd), tag
and select tokens, render the HTML viewer, and run the CLI.

## Optional extras

The converter for evaluation frameworks lives behind extras so the framework
itself doesn't become a hard dependency.

### Inspect AI

For [Inspect AI](https://inspect.aisi.org.uk/) eval log conversion:

``` bash
pip install "inif[inspect]"
```

This pulls `inspect-ai`, which is required to call
[`from_eval_log`](../converters/inspect_ai.qmd) /
[`from_eval_file`](../converters/inspect_ai.qmd) on `.eval` files.

### every_eval_ever (EEE)

For streaming records from the
[`evaleval/EEE_datastore`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/evaleval/EEE_datastore)
HuggingFace dataset:

``` bash
pip install "inif[evaleval]"
```

This pulls `datasets`. Local JSON / JSONL conversion via
[`from_eval_json`](../converters/evaleval.qmd) does not need this extra.

## From source

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/ndif-team/inif
cd inif
make dev      # or: uv sync --all-extras
```

`make dev` installs the package in editable mode together with the dev tools
(`pytest`, `ruff`, `ty`) and Quarto-based docs dependencies.

## Verify the install

``` bash
inif --help
```

If the CLI prints its subcommands (`view`, `convert`), the install is good.
